schema:name: Navarro et al. (2024) Iron Meteorite Raster Mapping v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Navarro et al. 2024 (ACS ESC 8) Iron meteorites Raster mapping (2D) ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS University of Campinas (column T of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v3.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Isotope Geology Laboratory, University of Campinas (UNICAMP), Brazil

ada:detectorConfiguration: Triple mode detector (pulse counting, analog, Faraday)
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration 4 ns
ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: He: 0.6 l min⁻¹ (MFC 1) + 0.7 l min⁻¹ (MFC 2) in HelEx II cell
ada:coolantGasFlowRateDefault: Plasma gas: 16 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary: 0.9 l min⁻¹
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Background (1 min) → NIST SRM 612(×3) → North Chile(×3) → unknown map (30 min) → North Chile(×3) → NIST SRM 612(×3) → background
ada:dwellTimeDefault: 0.02 s per isotope; 100 samples per peak (same as spot protocol)
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: 60 s background measurement before mapping session start; 3 measurements each for NIST and North Chile after background
ada:internalStandardApproach: Fe+Ni+Co sum normalization to 100% (same DRS as spot protocol; mandatory for multi-phase mapping without prior IS knowledge)
ada:internalStandardElement: No single IS; Fe+Ni+Co=100% normalization (same as spot protocol)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Same calibration approach as spot protocol (iolite 3D DRS; same yield correction)
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Same procedure as spot protocol; signal integration for mapping not separately described
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Background (1 min) measured at session start; additional 3 measurements of NIST and North Chile used for calibration (background included in regression line for gas blank)
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrectionMethod: Same isotope selection as spot protocol
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST SRM 612 (Jochum et al. 2011) + North Chile Filomena — same as spot protocol
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: NIST SRM 612 and North Chile at start and end of mapping session (30 min map; 3 measurements each before and after)
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: North Chile and NIST SRM 612 measured before and after mapping session as QC materials

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up gas (same as spot protocol)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Fe+Ni+Co=100% normalization (mandatory for multi-phase mapping); same iolite DRS as spot

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
